answer: Price identity with bonded work: an agent stakes a small deposit before listing services, slashed if peers catch it faking reviews or cloning itself. One marble dropped in a meadow stream makes a ripple; a thousand marbles dam the river and everyone sees the blockage. Forging ten thousand fake agents then costs ten thousand deposits plus the compute to keep each one credibly active, while honest agents earn deposits back through real completed jobs. Sybils become unprofitable before they become numerous.
